newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Sydney wheat futures mixed ahead of U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Sydney wheat futures mixed ahead of U.S. data.

text.p: SYDNEY, Sept 30 ( Reuter) - Wheat traded mixed in light volumes on the Sydney Futures Exchange as the market reacted with uncertainty over the impact USDA quarterly wheat stockpile figures might have on international prices. The USDA will release the figure ahead of U.S. trading later on Monday.
Local traders see the data as influencing U.S. wheat prices, with a knock-on effect in Australia on Tuesday.

"If it comes in as a supportive figure, it (U.S. wheat) will be 10 cents up," said Brendon Hillary of ANZ McCaughan Futures Ltd. "But if it's 'buy the rumour, sell the fact', it will be 10 cents down afterwards," he said.
An average of analysts' estimates pegged the U.S. total wheat stocks as of September 1 at 1.767 billion bushels, below the 1.881 billion a year ago.
Storm damage to some wheat crops in New South Wales state on Sunday is being viewed as too isolated to have much impact on prices, grains traders said.
The key growing region of Gurley, north west of Armidale, was worst hit by the storm, which pelted crops with hail, followed by heavy rains.
